title: Guest Network & Bandwidth Control
summary: Builds an isolated guest LAN on 192.168.200.0/24 with its own DHCP server, firewall zone and optional guest Wi-Fi.

items.title: Setup Guest Network (Interface + Firewall)
items.description: Creates the guest interface, its DHCP range and firewall rules that allow internet access only.
items.usage_tip: Guests can reach DNS and DHCP but are rejected when trying to reach the main LAN.

items.title: Setup Guest WiFi
items.description: Broadcasts the guest SSID on all radios with client isolation enabled.
items.usage_tip: The guest network is created automatically if it does not exist yet.

items.title: Bandwidth Control (QoS)
items.description: Opens the QoS sub-menu to limit guest download and upload speed.
items.usage_tip: Set limits before sharing your connection with many devices.

items.title: Remove Guest Network
items.description: Deletes the guest interface, DHCP entry, firewall rules and every guest Wi-Fi interface.
items.usage_tip: Your main Wi-Fi and LAN settings are left untouched.

items.title: Back
items.usage_tip: Nothing is removed while using this option.
